searchText: One another thing I forgot to mention on that topic is comparison between `justified` in PoS and `k-confirmations` in PoW. It is required either 384 seconds network delay or 2/3 dishonest for `justified` to be reorged (or anything in between of combination of these two). In PoW it is 13 seconds and 1/2 dishonest respectively. `justified` comes with much weaker assumptions than `k-confirmation` rule in PoW Yup. excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
One another thing I forgot to mention on that topic is comparison between `justified` in PoS and `k-confirmations` in PoW. It is required either 384 seconds network delay or 2/3 dishonest for `justified` to be reorged (or anything in between of combination of these two). In PoW it is 13 seconds and 1/2 dishonest respectively.

`justified` comes with much weaker assumptions than `k-confirmation` rule in PoW

excerpts.author: ekryski
excerpts.content: My bigger concern is how some of the on-chain DeFi contracts and bridges determine finality, especially if they are immutable. I haven't dove into many of them but my gut says there may be an attack vector there by having enough stake to mess with the CL and EL block order if they're purely relying on blocks.
